name: Zhou Mum Cafe
reviews:
Absolutely lovely and sweet people, this place is my regular go to, for just 13 bucks you get more than enough food for a family of four!
Ive tried multiple restaurants in this lane for Chinese food, and nothing quite hits the mark like they do.

Careful about how much you pay when you use card! I went in today and ask for a box of food, normally it cost $12.50. And today they tried to make me pay $17 when I tap the card if I did not see the pos machine.
Owner is really kind, the service is amazing and the food is out of this world.
Chinese food count style restaurant. Cheap, Good range of choice and taste alright. Big potion, and free for rice refill.

Well, if you're about to be out of money and want to have an ultra-large portion, this is the best place that I can offer around UNSW!

For $14, you'll get MOUNTAINEOUS rice with 3 dishes, which also comes with a free drink!

MONEY SPENT WELL HERE!
